changes.title: Call from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage shrinks on a phone and the number cannot be tapped. The sketch puts a tap to call button at the top.

changes.title: A way to request service.
changes.text: The Contact page form no longer loads. The sketch adds a Request service button right under the headline.

changes.title: Your services up front.
changes.text: Residential repairs, water heaters, remodels and commercial work lead the page.
